title: Analyze Receipt Extension
description: Extends receipt.base.schema.json. Module-specific fields for the Analyze module.

method_used.description: RCA method selected based on problem type.

root_cause_identified.description: True if a root cause was identified at any confidence tier.

root_cause_confidence.description: Confidence in root cause: >=0.7 confident, 0.4-0.69 probable, <0.4 speculative.

root_cause_summary.description: One-sentence root cause statement. Required when root_cause_identified is true.

contributing_factors_count.description: Number of contributing factors identified (not the root cause itself).

evidence_sources.description: Paths or drawer IDs consulted as evidence.

rca_report_path.description: Path to the full RCA report. e.g. .wabblespec/analysis/rca-<timestamp>.md

nexus_queried.description: True if Nexus was called for cross-session context before analysis.
